market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil >$101, rising Treasury yields post-Bessent backfire, and expanding trade wars. Expect 3-5% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks. Energy outperforms; tech resilient on AI momentum but vulnerable to rate spikes. Dollar weakness supports EM and commodities. Key risk: further Iran escalation pushing oil to $110+.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle (Qualcomm, Palantir, Accenture-Google) supports 12-month equity upside. Energy transition (Brazil power boom, pipeline M&A) creates structural winners. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, US-Iran) raises input costs, pressuring margins. China's inflation uptick signals global demand recovery. Rate normalization likely continues, capping multiple expansion but supporting financials.
